newsitem.title: GERMANY: German MAG wants to upgrade Ukraine sugar plants.
newsitem.headline: German MAG wants to upgrade Ukraine sugar plants.

text.p: Germany's Maschinen- und Anlagenbau Grimma GmbH (MAG) said on Friday it was seeking a 100 million mark contract to modernise five sugar refineries in Ukraine.
MAG's project manager Guenter Ruloff told Reuters in response to an inquiry that he was "hopeful" of the projects going ahead.
MAG is negotiating with various banks to arrange the necessary credits to finance the work, but intends only to provide equipment and know-how itself.
Ukraine, like other countries in the Commonwealth of Independent States, is struggling to revive its run-down industry and wean itself off dependence on bartered sugar imports from Cuba.
